function: F-01.1 + F-01.2 — Enable definition of autopilot target values (altitude, heading, speed) so the autopilot can be configured for engagement, AND ensure entered values are valid by warning/preventing impossible or unsafe entries. Note: F-01.2 (validation) is flagged as a shared function reusable across other parameter-entry requirements.
function_summary: Set and validate autopilot targets (altitude, heading, speed)
behaviour: Be-01.2 — Keyboard/button pathway as the primary means: the pilot enters the autopilot target values using physical buttons and a small keypad, with the system warning when an entry is invalid. Touch remains available as a fallback per project rule.
behaviour_summary: Physical keypad entry as primary input, touch as fallback.
structure: S-01.3 — Rotary knobs/buttons around the main display (WAD bezel) to nudge values step-by-step, plus a numeric keypad panel (UCP) for direct entry of large value jumps, plus the main display (WAD) showing the values and turning red on invalid input.
structure_summary: Dual-input control interface: bezel knobs, keypad, and validating display.
